articles.summary: GLP-1 spend is costly when it doesn’t turn into lasting results, and waste concentrates at three points in the medication journey: starting medication unnecessarily, stopping early, and restarting after weight regain.
articles.title: Controlling GLP-1 Waste with Dietitian-Led Care

articles.summary: In a newly presented study of patients with type 2 diabetes, Nourish care was associated with a clinically meaningful improvement in blood sugar, with average A1c falling 1.37 points after six months.
articles.title: A1c Below ADA Target in Six Months: New Nourish Data Shows the Impact of Dietitian-Led Care on Blood Sugar for Adults with Diabetes
